topic: Technical issues with frame generation and binding
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered several technical points regarding implementation. It was determined that `frame.id` cannot be generated in the storage layer and must be handled client-side. A bug was identified in 'dual binding' where clicking a tile after hiding a chart does not register immediately, requiring multiple clicks to function.

Separately, there is an issue with card charts: if a graph is hidden from a card chart, the first click (or hover) on the same metric within the card value area may not correctly pass the value to `@Input`.

Regarding campaigns, it was suggested that [me], [p1], and someone else should meet to align understanding before connecting to future meetings with Serjio. Status meetings for Brazil are tentatively scheduled weekly.
decisions: frame.id generation must occur on the client side.
A meeting is needed involving three parties (including [me] and [p1]) to synchronize understanding of campaigns.
action_items: [p1] will visit [me]'s location in the co-working space.
